selftest --mutate-tools replaces each check with always-PASS and always-FAIL to prove the corpus exercises it.
One-shot KB backtest at T=2026-10-15 over the 10-15..10-23 deliveries, against base-rate and contract-only forecasters. A cheap, falsifiable test of whether the KB adds value.
Conflict-of-interest rule: a fix to a check that is blocking your own delivery never applies to that delivery.
MM-1 (sealed E3 frontier) is the only progress metric, and every other diagnostic is shown with its tension pair. There is no composite score.
Sunset path for checks with zero catches over 10 or more deliveries. GATE_DIFF is auto-generated whenever an assertion changes.

loopholes_found: Salami tier gaming (MFG-1). The tier is computed from lock.budget, which the executor declares. Splitting a study into several tier-1 deliveries under 10 CPU-h each never triggers cross-agent review, canaries or official gates. Tier-1 outputs still produce FINDINGS rows and next-step memos that steer the program. Needed: cumulative lineage cost from receipts, as in MSDP and LaL.

Self-reported control receipts. writes_by_channel and state_digest are written by the executor's runner. If the counter sits behind the same policy function that misroutes writes (Package B's branch_allows), lesion arms report 0 writes while writing. The 'digest differs from W' check passes under any incidental nondeterminism even when no lesion was delivered.

Row provenance is self-reported. OUTPUTS.jsonl fields own_eos, answer_path='native' and emitted_hex are written by the runner. An evaluator-length truncation or a fitted EOS head can be labelled native/own_eos=true, and the canonical scorer trusts the labels. Needed: independent recomputation of own-EOS from stream_hex, plus a reviewer spot-check of answer_path.

Lock-before-look is unverifiable for uncommitted runs. An agent can score dev worlds from an uncommitted working tree, tune, then commit the lock and rerun. Git order still shows the lock first. MFG-1 dropped the attempt and resource ledger that would expose the earlier runs.

Nominal E3-cadence compliance. The cadence rule only checks objective_distance.opens_held_E3=true. An agent can attach a token, underpowered held-E3 endpoint to component work every third delivery and never seek a waiver.

Predictions as rote compliance. LOCK-11/PRD-001 require only that predictions exist and cite findings or 'none'. Copying the base rate, or using very wide intervals, satisfies the rule at zero cost. Proper scoring gives zero skill but does not block anything.
Vacuous findings. The mandatory 1-3 FINDINGS rows per delivery (CLM-11) can be filled with low-content rows that have formally complete conditions. This also pollutes the KB that predictions cite.
Soft-word lint synonyms. The banned list (largely, nearly, promising...) is closed, so 'substantially', 'broadly', 'close to', 'consistent with success' or 'encouraging' pass CLM-06.

Spoofed identity. The Acting-Agent trailer and REVIEW.json identity fields are free text. Codex, committing as Pencilbard, can write 'Acting-Agent: claude', so a fabricated 'cross-agent' review satisfies REV-01 mechanically. Only owner relay and spot-checks guard this.

Fabricated owner decisions. USER_DECISIONS rows are agent-transcribed. A governed checker loosening needs only a UD trailer that resolves to an agent-written row with plausible 'verbatim' text. MSDP's one-time codes are the only mechanism that resists this, and they are costly.

Canaries are not held out from the executor. MFG-1's operators M01-M14 are public code. The reviewer's seed chooses only which arm, item or parameter is mutated, not the operator family. An executor can build artifacts that satisfy exactly those families, so the canary tests checker regression, not delivery-specific semantics.

Held-out incident recall can be shaped. The same agents author the held-out fixtures and later the checks, and the agent writing a fixture can make it easy or hard for the frozen checker. Needed: fixture author != checker author, with the fixture committed by hash before scoring.

Distinguishability gates satisfied by hash codes. ADM-INPUT (input contrast, leave-one-out prompt ID) is passed by any deterministic hash front end, whatever its transfer. The designs acknowledge this but leave admission as a gate that only stops a run. Structure meters (LaL) should be required next to it.
Advisory-window timing (LaL). New rules are advisory for 2 deliveries, so a risky delivery can be scheduled inside the window to avoid a just-added check.

Degraded-mode self-review (MSDP). A Claude subagent with a committed prompt counts as a separate session (L1). One agent can spawn subagents to self-review and reach T2 with review debt that is never repaid if the debt cap is not reached.

Weak but fail-closed decision rule. RED fixtures test fail-closed properties, not strength. With margins set exactly at the CONSTRAINTS floors and a lenient per-world rule, decide() passes every RED check while staying permissive. The floors themselves become the target.
must_have_in_final: Start from MFG-1's skeleton: about 3 skills (stage-gates, claims-publish, independent-audit), one stdlib checker CLI and four choke points. Exit codes fail closed (missing, NaN or uncomputable = FAIL), with no --force or --skip.

Scaffolding commands so agents write less by hand. 'minifly_check.py init <dir>' writes an ENDPOINT_LOCK skeleton prefilled from CONSTRAINTS and the parent delivery. 'lock build' computes closure_sha256 from the AST import closure. Without these, agents will copy-paste locks.
Tier from max(declared, budget, cumulative lineage cost from receipts across same-protocol siblings). Official, confirmation, adoption and pointer stages are always tier 2.

Phase 0: retro in read-only mode on all 53 deliveries plus LEARNED-BANK, with measured recall on spot-checked incidents and a false-flag rate on clean ones. Then an advisory period of 2 deliveries per new rule (from LaL) before any gate blocks.

loop_version or checker_sha recorded in each lock, so a delivery is gated under the rules in force at its lock (from LaL). In-flight work, including the LEARNED-BANK main run, finishes under legacy rules and is only annotated.

A canonical program-wide scorer with the shortcut ladder and the LAD-02 substitution test. Own-EOS and the emitted bytes are recomputed from stream_hex, not trusted from runner labels. It must read rows from zip or gz result bundles via stdlib.
Cycle-0 testbed screen on the exact split: an evaluator-side ceiling must PASS and frozen random features must FAIL, otherwise CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED, before learner code is written.
RED reducer fail-closed fixtures on decide(), plus clean fixtures that must PASS.
Control differential done right: writes counted at the write site; the lesioned channel's digest must equal its birth or passive digest, not merely differ from W's; realized-dose floor.

Lock committed before the first scored value, with the Codex workflow accommodated. The lock is committed locally first. At tier 2 it is pushed if the owner authorized push_lock, or attested by the reviewer through an owner relay of the lock sha.

Closed-enum CLAIM.json with a generated headline that carries held exact own-EOS, best shortcut, G and best-of-k. Pointers are v1 copies of CLAIM fields; no bare pass booleans; narrowed findings must be cited.
Append-only FINDINGS and INCIDENTS JSONL without hash chains, with a union merge driver in .gitattributes so codex/* and claude/* branches merge cleanly.

Incident -> check plus synthetic corpus fixture, closed only when the fixture is caught. Held-out recall is scored with fixture author != checker author and the fixture committed by hash before scoring.

Governance: protected paths, GOV-SEP (no checker or skill change in a delivery's commit range), monotone-strictness selftest. Owner UD only for loosening, removal or a change to CONSTRAINTS; tightenings need a cross-agent review plus a passing selftest.

One executing cross-agent review per tier-2 delivery, timed after admission and before spend, including the cheapest-shortcut attempt. When the other agent is unavailable, record a REVIEW_DEBT row (from MSDP) that must be repaid before adoption or a pointer change.
Honest exits (CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED, TREATMENT_NOT_DELIVERED, NO_ADVANCE) as unpenalized first-class verdicts.

For E3-claiming deliveries only: LaL's U2C strata (S0 trivial and S1 presentation twins excluded from headlines) and the determinacy witness. UDI or leave-units-out is required only for an E3 promotion claim, not every T2 run.
Default caps for terse grants, and conditions in grants evaluated by someone other than the beneficiary (from MSDP and LaL).
A root AGENTS.md of at most 20 lines pointing to the skills, with a note that the owner's local rules take precedence pending reconciliation. No reliance on Claude-only hooks for enforcement.
Trigger predicates over lock fields so admission checks run only when the relevant component changed (from LaL), to control ceremony.
A cost meter: gate runtimes and ceremony_minutes, with a periodic prune review of checks with zero catches.
A one-shot KB backtest at T=2026-10-15 (from LaL) as an early falsifiable test of whether the KB has predictive value, not as a recurring ritual.
should_drop: MSDP's mandatory five-role separation, with an evaluator-owner from the other agent pushing EVAL artifacts before the executor's first commit at T2. Keep the clean-room reducer only for confirmation and adoption.
MSDP governor one-time codes from a TTY-only owner command, as a requirement. Offer them as an optional owner-chosen hardening.
HMAC commit-reveal seal salts with owner escrow, the vault family and the HOLDOUT touch registry. Defer until any candidate passes dev E3 (UF-27: none has).
Blind-phase and full-phase handoff packs, ACK cross-witnessing, and committed SESSION_PROMPTS.
PROTECTED_MANIFEST self-verification on every tool invocation, which bricks the kit on any drift. Replace it with a gate-time check that the checker sha equals the git HEAD blob (MFG-1 SELF-01).

runtime_guard and instrument.py as mandatory runner infrastructure: separate-process learner, sys.addaudithook OPEN_LOG heartbeat, InputTap. Defer until an incident shows silent leakage that manifest-level ADM-EXPO missed.
Decoy tripwires: decoy answer files, ignored override configs, decoy scorers. Every agent can read them, they lose value fast, and they risk false GOVERNANCE_BREACH.
Shingle-Jaccard COMMON_MODE_SUSPECT similarity scans.
Typed CYCLE_PLAN/CYCLE_RECORD with revision taxonomies, a seeded bug per cycle, and per-review PREMORTEM probabilities. These are the recurring per-cycle rituals the history shows become padding.
Hash-chained (prev_hash) ledgers, which break on cross-branch merges.
Claude PreToolUse hooks and git pre-commit hooks as enforcement layers, and session-start re-validation of every commit since a marker. Codex does not run them, and they are slow and fragile.
Thirteen (LaL) or ten (MSDP) skills. Consolidate to 3, at most 4.
Mandatory OC simulation for every design. Require it only for adoption or confirmation gates and small-N promotion rules.
UDI leave-units-out paired worlds at every T2. Require it only for E3 promotion claims.
Review canaries seeded into 1 in 5 review requests, reviewer scorecards, per-agent calibration dashboards, and MM-2..MM-10 reporting at this stage.
Recurring KB backtests with separate redactor and forecaster roles. Keep the single initial backtest.

The 100% detect plus clean-pass requirement across dirty and clean fixtures for all of FM-01..FM-30 before any merge. Start from the top-8 incident corpus (MFG-1's C00-C20) and grow it from incidents.
MFG-1's owner UD for tightening changes. Require owner UD only for loosening.
MFG-1's mandatory 1-3 FINDINGS rows per delivery. Allow 0 with a stated reason, to avoid vacuous rows.
Downgrade MFG-1's CLM-06 soft-word lint to WARN, except within the sentence carrying the primary gate token.

fatal_flaws: The executor writes verdict.py decide(), and it is tested only on public, deterministic RED-01..09 fixtures (candidate exactly 0.9, controls at chance). A decide() that recognises those fixtures behaves correctly on them and stays permissive on real, non-round rows. LOCK-08-ISO bans imports, not logic of the form 'if values look synthetic'. The design removed per-delivery metric code but kept per-delivery decision code.

Governance runs on the honour system. GOV-UD accepts any 'User-Decision: UD-nnnn' trailer that resolves to a row in USER_DECISIONS.jsonl, and agents transcribe those rows themselves. An agent can append a fabricated UD row, commit a loosened checker in a separate range (which satisfies GOV-SEP), and then gate its delivery under the new HEAD checker. SELF-01 only blocks uncommitted edits. The design itself admits no in-repo authentication.

Commit-reveal seeds are deferred until 'a candidate passes dev E3'. The first near-E3 confirmation is exactly when grinding worlds pays off. Official world ids are chosen by the executor, and WLD-01 only checks that they never appear in committed JSON, so an executor can pre-screen candidate world sets offline and lock the favourable ones. There is also no program-level confirmation ledger, so forking N deliveries and publishing the one that passes is invisible.

G is computed only against a no-prior-teaching control. A learner with supplied addition, gated on 'any teaching event occurred', fails the control and passes W, so G is large. There is no leave-units-out or unit-ablation test that would show the held answers depend on the specific taught units.

The held-out evidence is not held out. Canary operators M01-M14 are fixed and public, and canary.py is deterministic and runnable by anyone, so the executor can loop over seeds before review. 'Held-out incident recall' is to come from the pre-Full151 archive, but ARCHIVE_DIGEST.md is already in the designing session's scratchpad. Its FC01 (the N_old_rel no-op via branch_allows, 28 Sep) is the same defect as corpus fixture C01 (Package B), so recall on it is contaminated.

Many key quantities are declared rather than computed: objective_distance.opens_held_E3 (a boolean), trivial_strata_excluded, strata_required, arms[].zero_channels, ports[], gates[].used_in_verdict, files.native and lock.budget. An agent can declare narrowly so that checks have nothing to bite on: empty zero_channels skips ADM-CTRL, the forbidden fitted head goes in files.runner where LOCK-07 does not scan, and the budget is set to 9.9 CPU-h to stay tier 1. Without a resource ledger, actual compute is never checked against declared compute.

kb-score measures skill against a Laplace base rate of about 0.1 for native E3. Confidently predicting failure (p=0.02) when failure is near-certain yields Brier skill of about 0.96, so a 'KB generalizes' headline can come from pessimism alone. Calibration is also one of the kit's three scores, which rewards sandbagging: predict FAIL, then execute half-heartedly.

Exposure checking is manifest-level only (ADM-EXPO over executor-declared exposure_streams). This is the V6 FM-12 failure again: a held-answer 'calibration' stream that is left undeclared, or declared feedback_bearing=false, passes.

CLM-11 requires the publishing agent to append 1-3 FINDINGS rows at every tier with no independent reconciliation. That poisons the knowledge base that predictions and kb-score are built on, and the fixed count invites manufactured findings.
best_ideas: One canonical, program-owned scorer and shortcut ladder computed from saved OUTPUTS.jsonl including pre-stop stream_hex (CM-FIXED0..8 of the arm's own stream). No delivery code computes the gated metric.

LAD-02 substitution test: the locked rule must FAIL when the candidate's rows are replaced by the best shortcut's. LAD-03: every declared comparator must score at least the best shortcut, otherwise WEAK_COMPARATOR.
Fixed stage bundles (lock, roster, official), so agents cannot choose which failure classes apply. Missing, null or NaN counts as FAIL. No --force or --skip flags.

CLAIM.json and the headline are generated, and CURRENT_* pointers are byte-copies of CLAIM fields with claim_sha256 and a narrowing-row citation (PTR-02/04). This closes the prose channel for the layer agents read first.
AMD-03: a testbed_invalid amendment must show an ADMISSION testbed table on the original endpoint, so 'the task was bad' cannot be asserted after the fact.
designs_tried_k is computed from distinct native_closure_sha values (mechanical, independent of labels). It should be extended to distinct (closure, params) pairs.
Retro mode is read-only, and false flags are measured on clean deliveries before the owner freezes v1.
An explicit 'deliberately left out' list, plus a prune review of checks with zero catches. This is the only design that seriously controls ceremony.
LOCK-12: the analytic SNR is checked at design time, which catches V6-R1 from its own formulas.
The canary does catch declaration minimisation as a side effect. For example, M01 fails if a lesion arm declares no zero_channels, so a delivery cannot make checks vacuous by declaring nothing.

fatal_flaws: Degraded mode claims that commit-reveal 'still binds a single agent'. It does not. An agent that generated the salt can compute HMAC(salt, candidate_lock_sha, ...) for many candidate lock commits offline (varying a comment nonce), simulate the learner on each derived world set, and push the favourable lock. DEGRADED_CROSS_SESSION is nevertheless allowed up to T2. The salt must be unknown to whoever locks: owner-supplied after the lock is pushed, or held by the other agent family.

The one-time governor codes are bound to a digest that the agent computes and presents. The agent can describe scope A in prose and show digest8 of scope B; the owner types 'APPROVE <digest8> <code>' and cannot verify the binding without running the tool himself. The token generator (governor tokens --generate) is also agent-written code that the owner runs but cannot audit, and a malicious generator could make codes predictable.

Identity rule I1, 'namespace of the first remote branch containing the commit', cannot be computed from git: `branch -r --contains` reports current membership, not first appearance. The ordering checks (seal before lock, lock before reveal) rely on merge-base ancestry, which proves DAG order, not push time. A locally assembled history can satisfy all of them.

'Sealed procedural canaries' come from a public, deterministic generator (meta canary --seed-commit). A proposer can enumerate seeds offline before submitting the SCP, so they are not held out against the proposer.

Trigger predicates (new port, new control, front-end change) and revision classes (OPS/IMPL vs SCI) are evaluated over fields the executor declares in SPEC and CYCLE_RECORD. Retagging an outcome-driven eta0 change as IMPL avoids the best_of_k increment and spent held sets. Declaring the read path 'retained' avoids the input-discriminability check.
Cumulative tier counts only 'same-protocol siblings', so bumping protocol_id splits one investigation into several T1 deliveries.

Practicality: every T2+ delivery needs an evaluator-owner from the other agent family, coordinated through the user's relay, plus a governor code for each T2 launch and two at T3. Expected effects are owner fatigue (rubber-stamping the digest), routine fallback to degraded mode, and review debt 'repaid' by cursory reconciliations.

The evaluator-owner becomes a new common mode with measurement power, and a team-aligned evaluator can build a lenient composition map. The author can close a BLOCKER with REFUTED/NONE_NEEDED without the reviewer counter-signing.
The automatic simplification SCP triggered by ceremony-budget overrun, together with self-logged 'governance' time, gives agents a way to manufacture pressure toward loosening.
best_ideas: Hard exclusivity: the evaluator-owner is never the executor. The reducer, gates, sealed splits and composition map are written from SPEC text by the other principal, and executor commits under eval/ are detected (EXECUTOR_EDITED_EVAL).
Commit-reveal with an evaluator-held salt escrowed to the governor, leak canaries with arbitrary sealed targets (INVALID_LEAK), and sealed per-world relabelings.

Owner authentication that does not rely on git identity (one-time codes). This is the right direction, provided the owner verifies a human-readable scope and generates codes with an auditable OS one-liner.
Blind-then-full review: the PHASE1 commit precedes access to the narrative, and challenge mutants are seeded from the reviewer's own commit.
meta classify runs the old and new toolchains, extracted with git archive, on corpus plus canaries. Unclassifiable changes count as loosen. Changes apply only to later locks.
COMPOSITION_MAP with novelty types and unit-ablation difference-in-differences.
Facts are curated by a principal other than the executor, and a fact is TRANSFERABLE only after correct predictions on at least 2 substrates.
Defaults for terse grants (2 CPU-h, 5k records, no official run). Neutral option framing with no '(Recommended)' in labels. Conditionals evaluated by a non-beneficiary.
A REVIEW_DEBT ledger with a hard stop at 3 outstanding debts.

fatal_flaws: 'Each cycle catches at least one seeded bug drawn from the regression corpus': the executor chooses, plants and catches its own bug. This is a self-generated canary with zero information, and pure ceremony.

Trigger predicates run over SPEC fields the executor declares (LINEAGE ops retained/adapted/replaced, 'task is new'). At T1, testbed validity and E0 contrast run only if their triggers fire. 'Unresolved path counts as fired' does not help against a resolved but false declaration, and there is no computed code diff against the parent.

Owner DECISION rows matching diff_sha256 are still recorded by agents. CODEOWNERS, branch protection or signed tags are only recommended, so a fabricated loosen decision passes GOV-001 until the owner enables a git-level anchor.

Prospective loop_version gating reads RULES.json at the lock commit, but check code at HEAD, so a loosened check function applies retroactively. Locks never expire, so an agent can 'bank' many cheap locks under a lax version before a tightening and use them later.
ROLES.json role mapping is self-declared, so a fitted EOS head or int()-based digit parse can sit in a 'runner' file that AST-006 does not scan. answer_path provenance is tagged by runner code.

The U2C pair_rectangle witness is public. A learner with supplied addition that answers only when the supporting corners were taught produces UDI > 0. Without sealed symbol relabeling, supplied arithmetic is caught only by review.
The 'fresh session' KB-backtest forecaster runs in a container holding the full repo and git history. KB-001 scans the snapshot, not what the forecaster can access, so post-T leakage is likely.
The receiving author records REFUTED on review findings, and blocking findings can be closed without reviewer or owner counter-sign.

Size: 13 skills, about 17 modules, and many artifacts per T2 delivery. Pressure to stay in T0/T1 is likely, and 'advisory for 2 deliveries' at rollout means early deliveries can ignore everything. The tripwire file names are documented in the protected-paths list and are easy to avoid.
best_ideas: UDI closes the teaching-as-trigger hack that the no-prior-teaching control alone misses.
stats.decide is a program-owned decision module, and at T2+ the reducer is written by the EVALUATOR, so the executor never writes verdict logic.

The salt is generated by the EVALUATOR, its sha256 is committed before the lock, and it is revealed after the lock, so the executor cannot grind lock variants. Degraded single-agent mode is capped at T1, which avoids MSDP's false claim that seals bind a single agent.

Sealed canary batches authored by the owner or by a fresh session that did not write the tools, from FM definitions only. They are committed by hash before the tools under test merge, are the only truly held-out tests of the checker, and fixes that string-match the canary are rejected.

A conflict-of-interest rule: a fix to a check blocking your own in-flight delivery never applies to that delivery. Removed or unclassifiable changes count as loosen. An advisory period applies, and there is a sunset path.

R0-R4 transfer levels for both facts and checks. prediction_templates on facts automatically require in-scope predictions. The KB backtest compares base-rate, contract-only and KB forecasters; the contract-only arm is a KB ablation, which neutralises the 'confident pessimism' Brier inflation.
MM-1, the sealed E3 frontier, is the only progress metric. Diagnostics are shown in tension pairs and no composite score exists.
The owner traces 3 random claim numbers to raw artifacts at each census. This is the only anchor outside both agents.
Process separation: the learner runs as its own OS process exchanging bytes, the evaluator holds the answers, and the exposure audit is computed from the input tap rather than the manifest.

loopholes_found: FIXTURE-DETECTING DECISION RULE (MFG-1): the executor-written verdict.decide() special-cases the public, deterministic RED fixtures (candidate exactly 0.9, controls exactly at chance, synthetic world ids). It returns correct verdicts there and PASS on real rows. Closed by: a program-owned declarative rule (LaL stats.decide with locked parameters), or a reducer written by the non-executor (MSDP evaluator-owner, LaL EVALUATOR), plus property-based fixtures sampled from a reviewer seed.

SALT GRINDING / LOCK GRINDING: seeds are HMAC(salt, lock_sha). Whoever knows the salt before the lock is pushed can vary a comment nonce, compute the derived worlds for each candidate lock, pre-simulate, and push the favourable lock. This breaks MSDP's degraded mode, and breaks MFG-1 totally because it has no seeds at all. Closed by: the salt held by the other agent family or by the owner (LaL), revealed only after an externally witnessed lock push, or the owner's post-lock message used as the salt. Never claim commit-reveal binds a single agent.

WORLD PRE-SCREENING FOR THE FIRST CONFIRMATION (MFG-1): official world ids are chosen by the executor. WLD-01 only checks that they never appear in committed JSON, so worlds screened privately offline pass. Commit-reveal is deferred until a candidate passes dev E3, which is exactly when this pays. Closed by: mandatory commit-reveal for every SEALED_CONFIRM now (stdlib hmac, seconds of cost).

FORK-AND-PUBLISH ACROSS DELIVERIES: run v1, v1b and v1c, each with its own fresh lock and sealed worlds, and publish the one that passes. Within-delivery best_of_k does not see this. Closed by: MSDP/LaL ALPHA_LEDGER, keyed by operation-signature family (not protocol_id), with every SEALED_CONFIRM attempt registered through the evaluator's reveal. MFG-1 lacks it.

DAG ORDER IS NOT TIME ORDER (all three): lock-before-results is checked through commit ancestry, remote containment or commit timestamps. All of these can be arranged locally before a single push of lock and results. Closed only by an external witness: the other agent's ACK of a pushed sha (MSDP cross-witness), a reviewer pre-launch attestation (MFG-1 fallback), server-side push events, or a salt revealed after the lock that determines the worlds.

TEACHING-AS-TRIGGER: a learner with supplied addition outputs answers only after any teaching event has occurred. It beats the no-prior-teaching control, so MFG-1's G is large. Closed by: LaL's leave-units-out UDI or MSDP's unit-ablation DiD (removing specific supporting units leaves its answers unchanged, so UDI is about 0).

WITNESS-AWARE SUPPLIED ARITHMETIC: the learner computes int(a)+int(b) only when the public pair_rectangle supporting corners were taught, which gives UDI > 0. No design mechanically detects supplied arithmetic beyond heuristics. Closed by: sealed per-world symbol relabeling (an opaque digit-byte bijection; MSDP lists relabelings as sealed), under which any ASCII-keyed prior fails. This changes the 'raw bytes' surface, so it needs Mr. Zhou's decision.

WEAKENED CAUSAL CONTROL: the no-prior-teaching or lesion arm is built by the executor and also cripples the read path, so W beats it for reasons unrelated to reuse. ADM-CTRL and CONTROL_DIFFERENTIAL check only that the declared channels differ. Partly closed by MSDP/LaL intervention manifests (must_fix quantities measured) and an evaluator-derived expectation from SPEC. Needs: equality of the control's state digest with W on all channels not declared changed, plus reviewer rederivation.

WEAK FLOOR / WEAK FROZEN: the executor's admit.py or cycle-0 runs FROZEN with tiny width or a bad readout learning rate, so the floor 'fails' and a separable task looks like a valid testbed (the CARRY/CMP pattern). Closed by: floor = best over a registered hyperparameter grid from a program-owned evaluator library, run or rerun by the non-executor (MSDP evaluator-owner).

DECLARATION MINIMIZATION (strongest in MFG-1; partly in MSDP/LaL): the executor declares empty zero_channels, fewer ports, gates as used_in_verdict=false, trivial_strata_excluded=[], narrow strata_required, a forbidden head in files.runner or a 'runner' role, and a budget just under the tier threshold. Checks keyed on declarations then have nothing to bite on. Closed by: computing these values (LaL computes strata from item content; native-purity scan over the runtime import closure of the learner process), CONSTRAINTS minimum lists, and canary operators chosen by arm role rather than by declaration.

SELF-SELECTED FAILURE CLASSES (MSDP/LaL triggers): declare 'read path retained' or 'task not new' to avoid E0 or testbed checks. Closed by: MFG-1-style fixed bundles at T2+, or triggers computed from a code diff of the native closure against the declared parent (MSDP lockcheck has the lineage diff but uses it only for a label).

RELABELED SCIENCE: an outcome-driven eta0 change or task switch is tagged OPS/IMPL/MEAS, or as an amendment with reason 'measurement_defect'. Closed by: best_of_k computed over distinct (native_closure_sha, params_sha) on any outcome-bearing run (an extension of MFG-1), and an owner decision for any change to primary or guard fields after outcomes (all three), with the original endpoint kept as headline co-primary.

INVISIBLE TUNING: sweeps run from scratch scripts that bypass the runner, runtime_guard and RESOURCE_LEDGER. No design can see them. The only robust defense is sealed held material the executor cannot access before the lock (commit-reveal) plus an evaluator-held answer generator.

CADENCE RESET BY HONEST EXIT: open a held-E3 endpoint on a deliberately untestable testbed, exit unpenalized with CANNOT_TEST, and the deliveries_since_E3 counter resets. Then run two more component deliveries. MFG-1's opens_held_E3 is a self-declared boolean. Closed by: counting a delivery as having opened E3 only if a powered (OC ≥ 0.8), non-trivial-strata held E3 primary passed admission and got a scored verdict. INCOMPLETE and CANNOT_TEST are recorded in base rates.

PROTECT OLD BY NOT LEARNING OLD: the OLD guard is own OLD_END minus own FINAL (all three). A weak OLD acquisition gives a drop of about 0. Closed by: the guard also requires OLD_END taught exact own-EOS above the best countermodel by a margin.

KB SKILL FROM PESSIMISM (MFG-1 kb-score): against a Laplace base rate of about 0.1 for native E3, predicting p=0.02 yields large Brier skill. Many easy admission-measurement predictions inflate it further. Closed by: LaL's contract-only (KB-ablated) forecaster comparison, and scoring KB skill only on primary and guard endpoints with non-degenerate base rates.

SANDBAGGING: MFG-1 makes prediction calibration one of the kit's scores, and LaL/MSDP report per-agent calibration. An agent predicts FAIL and then executes weakly. Closed by: never scoring agents or the kit on calibration. Only sealed G/MM-1 is progress, and calibration is a diagnostic of the KB, not of agents.

KB POISONING: MFG-1's CLM-11 makes the publishing agent append 1-3 FINDINGS per delivery at any tier, with no reconciliation. Closed by: MSDP (fact entry forces T2, curator ≠ executor) and LaL (FACT_DELTAS activated only by a reviewer ≠ author, LED-010).

FABRICATED OWNER DECISIONS: agents transcribe USER_DECISIONS/DECISIONS rows and trailers (MFG-1, LaL). Closed by: an owner-held authentication factor. Options are CODEOWNERS plus branch protection on protected paths, owner-signed tags, or MSDP one-time codes, provided the owner generates codes with an auditable OS one-liner and verifies a human-readable scope himself rather than an agent-supplied digest.

DIGEST SUBSTITUTION (MSDP): the agent shows scope A in prose and digest8 of scope B; the owner types APPROVE digest8 code. Closed by: the owner's verbatim text must contain the cap numbers, and the tool refuses when those numbers differ from the digested scope.

OVERFIT LOOSENING THAT STAYS 'MONOTONE': narrow a regex (exposure_overlap to exposure_overlap$) so every visible corpus fixture still fires but the agent's own delivery passes. GOV-MONO and corpus 100% both pass. Procedural canaries from a public generator (MSDP) can be enumerated offline. Closed only by LaL's sealed batches authored by a non-tool-author and committed by hash before merge, plus computed classification that treats unclassifiable changes as loosen.

CONTAMINATED HELD-OUT INCIDENTS: the pre-Full151 archive is already digested in this design session's scratchpad (ARCHIVE_DIGEST.md). Its FC01 (the 28 Sep N_old_rel no-op via the same branch_allows) is the Package B defect behind corpus fixture C01, so 'held-out recall' on the archive is inflated. The agent converting an incident into a fixture can also render it in a form the checker already catches. Closed by: treating the archive as training data and building held-out fixtures from incidents first recorded after a checker freeze, by an author who has not read the checker code (LaL canary rule).

LOCK BANKING (LaL prospective versioning): make many cheap locks under a lax loop_version before a tightening, then launch them later. Check code is also read at HEAD, not at the lock. Closed by: running the full toolchain at the lock commit through git archive (MSDP meta classify mechanics), lock expiry, and always using the latest strictness for T3.

SELF-REFUTED BLOCKERS (all three): the author reconciles a blocking finding as REFUTED, or NONE_NEEDED, and launches. Closed by: a REFUTED blocker requires reviewer counter-sign or owner ruling (MSDP DISPUTED_ESCALATED, made mandatory).

SELF-GENERATED CANARIES: LaL's 'each cycle catches a seeded bug', MSDP's seeded_bugs_caught, and MFG-1's fixed operator set M01-M14 that the executor can pre-run for any seed. Planted canaries must come from a party that does not benefit from the pass, and must not be enumerable by the executor.

INDEPENDENCE THEATER: a Claude session writes a REVIEW.json and an Acting-Agent: codex trailer. A Claude parent spawns a Claude subagent 'reviewer' with a steering prompt. Trailers and JSON identity fields are self-written in all three designs. Partly closed by: harness-enforced branch namespaces (claude/* vs codex/*) recorded at hand-off by the other party's ACK, reviewer recall measured by third-party review canaries (LaL, MSDP I7), and the owner's spot-check. Same-family sessions never satisfy T2+ independence.

OUTPUT FABRICATION AND MISLABELED ANSWER PATH: the runner writes OUTPUTS rows, including emitted_hex, own_eos and answer_path=native, and it knows expected_hex (MFG-1). Closed by: the evaluator process spawns the learner and records its raw bytes (LaL/MSDP process separation), plus a reviewer-seeded deterministic replay of a random subset of official (world, arm) histories with output-digest equality.

PROSE INFLATION OUTSIDE LINTED SPANS: soft-word bans apply only near gate words. 'The held relation was substantially acquired' or 'encouraging step toward E3' in the REPORT body or the next-design memo passes. Closed mostly by generated headlines and pointers (MFG-1), and by number-to-artifact binding (LaL CLM-005) extended to memos that cite prior numbers.

TIER SALAMI: split one investigation into several T1 deliveries by bumping protocol_id or declaring a different parent (defeats MSDP 'same-protocol siblings' and LaL lineage), or under-declare the budget (MFG-1, with no ledger). Closed by: cumulative cost keyed by operation-signature or native-closure overlap, a mechanical resource ledger, and the rule that nothing below T2 can produce facts, pointers or confirm wording.

PRUNING VIA SELF-REPORTED COST: inflate CLAIM.ceremony_minutes (MFG-1) or logged 'governance' time (MSDP auto-simplification SCP) to get disliked checks pruned. Closed by: pruning decisions based only on measured runtime and on catches (live plus canary), with the owner deciding.
must_have_in_final: MFG-1's architecture as the base: one canonical, program-owned scorer and shortcut ladder over saved OUTPUTS (including stream_hex); the LAD-02 substitution test; LAD-03 comparator ≥ best shortcut; fixed stage bundles; missing = FAIL with no --force or --skip; generated CLAIM and headline; pointers as claim_sha256 copies.

No executor-authored decision code: a declarative rule evaluated by a program-owned decide, as in LaL stats.decide, with parameters in the lock. Where a custom reducer is unavoidable, it is written by the non-executor and tested with fixtures sampled from a reviewer seed.

Commit-reveal for every SEALED_CONFIRM from day one. The salt is unknown to the locker: held by the other agent family or the owner, or the owner's post-lock message serves as the salt. It is revealed only after an externally witnessed lock push. Single-agent mode is capped at T1 (LaL), never 'seals bind one agent'.

Temporal claims (lock before look, admission before spend) rest on an external witness: the other agent's ACK of a pushed sha, the reviewer's pre-launch attestation, or the salt reveal. They never rest on DAG ancestry or commit dates alone.

A causal-reuse test for any E3 claim beyond no-prior-teaching: LaL's leave-units-out UDI, or MSDP's unit-ablation DiD, on evaluator-computed strata (S2+ in the headline) with an evaluator-side determinacy witness.

Computed, not declared: tier (from a mechanical resource ledger and lineage by operation signature or native-closure overlap); opens_held_E3 (powered, non-trivial strata, admitted, scored); designs_tried_k over distinct (native_closure_sha, params_sha) on any outcome-bearing run; trivial strata from item content; native-purity scan over the runtime import closure of the learner process.

The E3-cadence counter is reset only by an admitted, powered, scored held-E3 primary. INCOMPLETE, CANNOT_TEST and NO_ADVANCE are recorded in base rates, so an honest exit stays unpenalized but cannot reset the cadence.

The strongest-floor rule: FROZEN and BP ceiling and floor learners come from a program-owned evaluator library with a fixed hyperparameter grid (floor = best over the grid), run or rerun by the non-executor.
The OLD guard combines a bound on own OLD_END minus FINAL with an absolute requirement that OLD_END acquisition exceeds the best countermodel.

Owner-authenticated changes to protected paths and loosenings, via an anchor agents cannot forge: CODEOWNERS plus branch protection, owner-signed tags, or one-time codes generated by an auditable OS one-liner. The owner's verbatim approval text must restate the cap numbers, and the tool checks them against the digested scope.

Truly held-out tests of the checker. Sealed canary batches are authored from FM definitions by the owner or a session that has not read the checker change, and committed by hash before merge (LaL). The pre-Full151 archive is treated as training data (it is already digested and overlaps C01). Held-out recall is reported only on incidents recorded after the freeze.

Prospective versioning of the whole toolchain: a delivery is gated by git archive of tools, rules and skills at its lock commit. Locks expire. T3 runs under the latest strictness. The conflict-of-interest rule from LaL applies.
A program confirmation ledger (alpha or e-value) keyed by operation-signature family, with every SEALED_CONFIRM attempt registered through the evaluator's reveal.

Facts enter the KB only after reconciliation by a principal other than the delivering author (LaL LED-010 / MSDP curator). KB skill is measured against a contract-only, KB-ablated forecaster on non-degenerate primary and guard targets, not against Laplace on near-certain failures.
Calibration, held-out recall and flag counts are never agent or kit scores. Sealed E3 G (MM-1) is the only progress metric, and diagnostics appear in tension pairs.
Any REFUTED blocking finding needs reviewer counter-sign or an owner ruling before launch.

Anti-fabrication: the evaluator process records the learner's raw output bytes, and after each run a reviewer-seeded deterministic replay of a random subset of official histories must match the output digest.
Cheap anchors outside both agents: the owner traces 3 random claim numbers at each census (LaL), and third-party review canaries measure reviewer recall.

Sealed per-world symbol relabeling (an opaque digit-byte bijection), offered to Mr. Zhou as a recorded decision. It makes 'no supplied arithmetic structure' mechanically testable, but it changes the raw-bytes surface, so it must not be adopted without his explicit decision.
should_drop: Executor-seeded bugs caught by the executor in each cycle (LaL minifly-cycles; MSDP CYCLE_RECORD.seeded_bugs_caught): self-generated canaries that carry no information.
Calling MFG-1's fixed public mutation operators (M01-M14) 'held-out canaries'. Keep them at most as a selftest smoke run, not as a tier-2 independence requirement.
MSDP's claim that commit-reveal binds a single agent, and T2 eligibility in degraded single-agent mode.
MSDP identity inference from the 'first remote branch containing the commit' (not computable), and ancestry-only ordering checks presented as proof of time order.
MFG-1's mandatory 1-3 FINDINGS rows per delivery at every tier: KB poisoning plus ritual.
Prediction calibration as part of the kit's score (MFG-1), and per-agent calibration used as an evaluation, which invites sandbagging.
A registered prediction for every admission measurement (MFG-1 LOCK-11). It inflates KB skill with trivially predictable items; keep predictions to primary and guard endpoints.

Pruning or automatic simplification driven by self-reported ceremony minutes or logged governance time (MFG-1 CLAIM.ceremony_minutes for prune, MSDP auto-SCP on overrun). Use measured runtime and catch counts.
Tripwire and decoy files described in the skills and protected-path lists (LaL, MSDP). Every agent can read them and avoid them; at most keep them as optional, undocumented owner-placed traps.

Byte-identical-file padding detectors and 8-token shingle Jaccard (MSDP) as primary anti-padding or common-mode defenses; both are evaded by a timestamp or a rename. Rely on executed outputs and SPEC-derived non-executor reducers.
A governor code for every T2 launch (MSDP). Owner fatigue turns it into a rubber stamp; batch, and reserve owner touches for T3, loosenings and amendments.

LaL's 13-skill and MSDP's 10-skill sprawl. Consolidate to about 4-5 skills (stage gates, unit-to-composition/E3 design, claims and knowledge, independent review, governance) to keep adoption and avoid T0/T1 route-around.
Soft-word ban lists as a blocking primary defense, because they are evaded by synonyms. Keep generated headlines and number binding; lint prose as advisory.

# MiniFly Research-Loop Kit v1 (MRK-1): final architecture

Status: the implementation specification for schema v1, which applies prospectively only. Synthesizer output from three candidate designs (MFG-1 minimal-enforcement, MSDP separation-of-duties, LaL loop-as-learner) and two judge panels (practicality, adversarial). Owner of objective and constraints: Mr. Changwei Zhou. This document is the single source of truth for the work packages; every check id, file name and schema named here is normative.

---

## 0. Thesis and provenance

**What history shows.** MiniFly's most expensive failures were silent, and most were detectable early from artifacts that already existed or were cheap to create:
- Package B: about 80 core-hours, a dead E3 control detectable after one technical receipt.
- STOP-ONLY: 225,792 records, a weak comparator detectable from its own saved stream.
- V6-R1: 34,816 records; its cue/noise ratio was already written in its own design formulas.
- v5.1: a port gate that could not fail.
- v4: a reversed teaching sign.
- LEARNED-BANK: an untestable task and a fail-open reducer.

Rules written as prose (the E0-E4 contract, the 10-14 continuity rules) existed and recurred as failures anyway.

**What MRK-1 does about it.** It turns the key rules into fail-closed machine checks and places them at four choke points where compute or credibility is spent:
1. LOCK, before the first scored value.
2. ROSTER, before spend beyond a technical allowance.
3. OFFICIAL, before a main or confirmation run.
4. PUBLISH/POINTER, before anything other agents read first.

One program-owned Python-stdlib checker (`tools/minifly_check`) owns everything that decides a verdict:
- the metric;
- the shortcut ladder;
- the strata;
- the decision rule.

A delivery supplies declarations and saved outputs, never verdict code. Cost scales with a computed tier. Honest exits are first-class and unpenalized. The kit's own improvement is governed so that agents cannot pass by editing it. Generalization is measured with numbers at two levels:
- **Learner:** taught units lead to determined, held-out compositions, scored against the strongest shortcut, with causal unit dependence.
- **Research loop:** unit facts and failure classes lead to predictions and checks, scored on future experiments and on sealed canaries.

**Base taken from MFG-1:**
- the four choke points and one stdlib checker;
- the canonical program-wide scorer and shortcut ladder, with the substitution test;
- missing = FAIL, with no `--force` or `--skip`;
- the generated CLAIM and headline, with pointers as byte copies;
- the Phase-0 retro with a measured false-flag rate before freeze;
- GOV-SEP;
- the explicit left-out list;
- the honest exits.

**Changed relative to MFG-1, to close loopholes the judges found:**
- The executor-written `verdict.py` is replaced by a declarative rule in the lock, evaluated by program-owned `decide.py`. This closes fixture-detecting reducers.
- own-EOS is recomputed from `stream_hex`.
- Control receipts use per-channel digests at the first manipulated record: unchanged on lesioned channels, and equal to W elsewhere.
- Tier includes measured, family-cumulative compute from a launch wrapper.
- The E3 cadence counter is computed, and resets only on an admitted, scored, main-world held-E3 primary.
- Every SEALED_CONFIRM uses post-lock two-party entropy.
- At tier 2, lock timing needs an external witness.
- Findings are activated only by the other agent family.
- Owner decisions are required only for loosening and constraints. Tightening needs a cross-agent review.
- Each delivery records 0-3 findings, with a reason when zero.
- Prediction calibration is never an agent or kit score.
- Canary operators are chosen by arm role and are explicitly not called held-out.
- `init` and `lock build` scaffolding are added.

**Grafted from LaL:**
- U2C: units fixed before streams, strata S0-S4 computed from item content, the determinacy witness, and the unit-dependency index (UDI) for E3 promotion only.
- An advisory window plus an `introduced_in` version per check.
- Triggers, computed and used only at T1.
- R0-R4 levels for facts and checks.
- `selftest --mutate`.
- A one-shot KB backtest against a contract-only forecaster.
- The conflict-of-interest rule.
- Sealed canary batches written by someone who did not author the checker.
- Sealed-world G as the only progress metric.
- An owner spot-check of 3 numbers per census.
- A sunset path for checks.

**Grafted from MSDP:**
- cumulative lineage cost;
- REVIEW_DEBT;
- default caps for terse grants;
- conditions evaluated by a non-beneficiary;
- hand-off by commit sha plus path;
- unexecuted findings marked UNVERIFIED;
- the V51 status legacy map;
- the cheapest-shortcut bounty;
- challenge seeds chosen by the reviewer after the lock.

**Dropped as ceremony or impractical** (several are deferred until an incident shows a silent failure they would have caught):
- five-role separation and an evaluator-owner at every T2 delivery;
- governor one-time codes as a requirement (now optional hardening);
- salt escrow, the vault family and the holdout touch registry;
- blind/full hand-off packs, ACK cross-witnessing and SESSION_PROMPTS;
- manifest self-verification on every call, which would brick the kit;
- runtime_guard, instrument.py, the input tap and a separate learner process;
- tripwires and decoys;
- shingle similarity;
- typed CYCLE_PLAN/CYCLE_RECORD revision taxonomies, seeded bugs per cycle and PREMORTEM;
- hash-chained ledgers, which break on cross-branch merge;
- Claude-only hooks as enforcement;
- 10 or 13 skills;
- OC simulation for every design and UDI at every T2;
- review canaries in 1 of 5 reviews, MM-2..10 dashboards and recurring backtests;
- 100% corpus coverage of FM-01..30 before any merge;
- ceremony_minutes;
- mandatory findings.

---

## 1. Scope, protected invariants, non-goals

**Protected invariants** live in `PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/KB/CONSTRAINTS.json` and are owner-defined. Weakening any of them requires a recorded USER_DECISIONS row containing Mr. Zhou's verbatim words.

- I1. Native line: no attention, Transformer, ELM or backprop. Evaluator-only ceiling learners are allowed, are labelled, and never sit on the native answer path.
- I2. No supplied arithmetic structure in the native line.
- I3. Raw-byte input plus allowed feedback, under the owner's gradual warmup (start ceiling 1/16).
- I4. Primary objective: retained, exact, own-output, own-EOS unseen addition at the final checkpoint, OLD protected, reported per sample and per actual counted compute.
- I5. The E0-E4 ladder of `minifly_b/package/DOCS/MINIFLY_OBJECTIVE_CONTRACT.md`. The report always states the level actually earned.
- I6. Confirm wording is allowed only for worlds_role SEALED_CONFIRM.
- I7. Tier-2 independence requires a reviewer from the other agent family (Codex vs Claude). Same-family sessions or subagents never count.
- I8. FINDINGS, INCIDENTS, USER_DECISIONS, DELIVERY_LEDGER, CONFIRM_LEDGER and REVIEW_DEBT are append-only.
- I9. Changes apply prospectively. Frozen designs, data, verdicts and adopted pointers are never edited. Corrections are new rows, errata or new deliveries.
- I10. Honest exits are unpenalized.
- I11. Only sealed-world G (Section 9.6) counts as program progress. Never PASS counts, cycles, gates added or flags avoided.
- I12. Evidence for the verdict comes only from locked code and the program checker. Measurements and verdicts are never hand-written.

**Applicability.** Schema v1 applies to delivery directories `<name>_{design|dev}_vN_YYYYMMDD` created after the owner's freeze decision (UD-0001) and containing `ENDPOINT_LOCK.json` with schema `minifly.endpoint_lock.v1`. All other directories are legacy, and only `retro` (read-only) touches them.

**Non-goals.**
- Tools never train or run learners.
- Tools never write inside legacy directories or into frozen designs.
- Tools never fetch from the network.
- Tools never alter historical verdicts or adopted pointers.

---

## 2. File tree

```
AGENTS.md                         root pointer for Codex (<=20 lines; protected)
.gitattributes                    PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/KB/*.jsonl merge=union (protected)
README.md                         + 6-line 'Research-loop kit (schema v1)' section
.claude/skills/

  minifly-e3-design/SKILL.md          references/RULE_GRAMMAR.md, references/ADMISSION_AND_RUNNER_CONTRACT.md, references/STRATA_WITNESS_UDI.md
  minifly-claims-knowledge/SKILL.md   references/CLAIM_AND_POINTERS.md, references/KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER.md
  minifly-independent-review/SKILL.md references/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md, references/SEAL_PROTOCOL.md
  minifly-governance/SKILL.md         references/CHANGE_CLASSES.md, references/HELDOUT_CANARIES.md
tools/minifly_check/              (all protected)

  lockcheck.py  seal.py

              ADMISSION.example.json RECEIPT.example.json OUTPUTS.example.jsonl TAUGHT.example.jsonl
              CLAIM.example.json POINTER.example.json admit_skeleton.py
```

---

## 3. The loop (the user's framing, with the weak points fixed)

The user's loop is explore -> experiment (design, refinement -> audit -> test run x3 -> official run) -> audit and search. MRK-1 keeps that shape and fixes eight weak points:

1. Cycle 0, a cheapest-falsifier testbed screen, runs before any learner code exists.
2. Cycles are typed, with mechanical exit criteria.
3. Cycles end on a decision, not on a count.
4. The rehearsal runs on a fresh world.
5. Outcome-informed design changes are counted automatically ("best of k").
6. The audit step is an executing cross-agent review at the cheap moment (after admission, before spend) at T2.
7. Official runs are never rerun.
8. Audit and search score predictions and feed findings and incidents back.

### 3.1 Stage map

`MFC` stands for `python3 -I tools/minifly_check/minifly_check.py`.

| User step | MRK stage | What happens | Blocking command | Exit criterion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| explore | S0 Explore (T0) | Read `MFC kb status`: cadence, open incidents, narrowed findings, review debts, sealed G series. Read FINDINGS conditions and caveats. Run the cheapest falsifier first: analytic SNR from init formulas, or saved-data reanalysis. Present options to the owner neutrally, each with cost and objective distance. | none (informational) | Owner AUTHORIZATION recorded for design/implementation |
| design | S1 Design and endpoint lock | `MFC init <dir> [--parent P]`. Fill ENDPOINT_LOCK: the contract block as fields, units, split, arms, rule, guards, worlds, predictions. Record AUTHORIZATION. | `MFC gate --stage lock <dir>`, then commit | Lock gate PASS. ENDPOINT_LOCK committed before any `results/**`. |
| refinement -> audit -> test run 1 | C0 Testbed screen (before learner code) | `admit.py --testbed` runs evaluator-side ceiling and floor grids on the exact split and budget. | `MFC launch --stage testbed <dir> -- python3 -I admit.py --testbed`, then `MFC score --role admission <dir>` | Ceiling passes and floor fails: continue. Otherwise CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED: stop, or amend with reason testbed_invalid. |

| audit | T2 review event | The other agent family runs executed checks, the cheapest-shortcut attempt and the canary, and attests the lock sha. | REVIEW.json, checked by REV-* and WIT-01 | decision ADMIT, with no open BLOCKER or MAJOR |

### 3.2 Typed cycles

Kinds:
- `testbed` (C0, not counted against the cap);
- `technical` (C1);
- `dev` (C2);
- `rehearsal` (C3).

Every cycle ends with `MFC cycle close <dir> --kind K --decision {continue|revise|stop|escalate} --reason "<one sentence>"`. This appends one CYCLES.jsonl row. The checker fills the computed fields:
- k;
- native_closure_sha and params_sha;
- attempts since the last close;
- the latest gate result;
- outcomes_readable;
- designs_tried_k so far.

Exit criteria, checked by CYC-02 whenever the decision is continue:

| Cycle | Exit criterion |
|---|---|
| testbed | A TESTBED result exists |
| technical | A PASS roster GATE report at the current SOURCE_LOCK |
| dev | `results/dev/SCORES.json` exists |
| rehearsal | A PASS `official --dry` GATE report |

Rules:
- The test-cycle cap is `AUTHORIZATION.caps.max_cycles` (default 3), counting technical, dev and rehearsal.
- A cycle kind may repeat within the cap.
- `launch` refuses new dev or rehearsal attempts beyond the cap.
- No per-cycle audit files, plans, predictions or revision taxonomies are written.
- designs_tried_k is computed, never declared: it is the number of distinct (native_closure_sha, params_sha) pairs over all outcome-bearing attempts and rows.

### 3.3 What a FAIL allows

| Failing family | Allowed responses (never: edit the checker, skip, hand-write numbers, rerun official) |
|---|---|
| SELF, SCHEMA | Commit or revert local checker edits through governance. Use `retro` for legacy. |
| LOCK-01..04, 10..12 | Fix ENDPOINT_LOCK before any results exist. After results exist, write an amendment (AMD rules). |
| LOCK-05..07 | Fix code or closure and rerun `lock build`. For a forbidden pattern, remove it or move it out of the native answer path. |
| LOCK-09 | Open a held-E3 endpoint, or obtain an owner waiver (UD scope `e3_waiver:<delivery>`). |
| AMD-* | Write AMENDMENTS row(s) with results_seen. Obtain a UD where required. Or revert the change. |
| ADM-TB | Verdict CANNOT_TEST_CLAIM_AS_SPECIFIED. Redesign through an amendment with reason testbed_invalid. |
| ADM-CTRL | INVALID with reason TREATMENT_NOT_DELIVERED. Fix the control and repeat the technical cycle on technical worlds only. |
| ADM-INPUT, ADM-ACQ | INPUT_STATE_NOT_ADMITTED or NOT_ACQUIRING. Redesign the learner (a new k) or stop. |
| ADM-EXPO | Regenerate streams or split under a new protocol_id (amendment). |
| RED-01 | The rule is unreachable. Amend it before any learner-arm outcome; no UD is needed if none exists yet. |
| REV, WIT | Obtain the review, or record REVIEW_DEBT (dev and pilot only). |
| Verdict FAIL, INVALID, INCOMPLETE | Report it. Never rerun official. A follow-up is a new protocol on fresh worlds. |
| CLM, PTR | Regenerate the claim. Fix the prose. Cite narrowing rows. |
| GOV | Split the commit. Obtain a cross-agent review or a UD. |

### 3.4 Forbidden moves

- Editing any protected path in a commit range that also touches a delivery.
- Changing a check to unblock your own delivery.
- Producing ADMISSION, receipts or OUTPUTS by hand.
- Running scored work outside `launch` at T2.
- Rerunning an official run.
- Switching task or metric to rescue a run.
- Using confirm wording off sealed worlds.
- Treating a memo's 'approved' as authorization.
- Judging your own conditional grant.
- Putting '(Recommended)' inside option labels.
- Writing integrity booleans as literals.
- Deleting predictions, findings or failed-attempt directories.

### 3.5 Not required (anti-ceremony)

- No per-cycle audit or review files.
- No compliance disclaimers or 'no parameter changed' notes.
- No hand-written STATUS booleans or verdict prose.
- No ceremony-minute logs.
- No predictions on admission measurements.
- No findings when there is nothing durable to record (0 with a reason).
- No review at T0 or T1.
- No typed revision taxonomy.
- Byte-identical review outputs across deliveries are flagged as padding (REV-07).

## 4. Stake tiers (computed, never declared down)

`tier = max(declared, tier(lock.budget), tier(measured ATTEMPTS of this delivery), tier(family cumulative CPU), stage floor)`. Thresholds are owner-set in CONSTRAINTS; proposed values are shown.

| Tier | When | Required | Cannot |
|---|---|---|---|
| T0 | No learner execution producing scored values (memos, saved-data reanalysis), and at most 1 CPU-h | Nothing new. If text is published: `MFC lint <files>` (CLM-06, CLM-12, CLM-16, PTR-*), and outputs stamped DEV_NOT_EVIDENCE. | — |
| T1 | Learner runs with scored values on technical, dev or rehearsal worlds only. Delivery at most 4 CPU-h and 20,000 records. Lineage family cumulative at most 12 CPU-h. | ENDPOINT_LOCK, SOURCE_LOCK, ADMISSION, launch wrapper, cycles, generated CLAIM (DEV or PILOT). Self-checked; no reviewer. | Activate findings, update pointers, use confirm wording, reset E3 cadence, adopt, run official |
| T2 | Above any T1 cap. Any official run (MAIN or SEALED_CONFIRM), findings activation, adoption, pointer update, or post-outcome amendment of primary or guard fields. | Everything in T1, plus: AUTHORIZATION covering the stage; one executing cross-agent review event; witness attestations (WIT-01); the published verification subset. SEALED_CONFIRM adds the seal, OC-01, a CONFIRM_LEDGER row and a post-run replay. | — |

Lineage family:
- Two v1 deliveries are in the same family when the Jaccard index of their native-closure file content hashes is at least 0.5.
- Families are connected components under that relation.
- family_id = `FAM-` + sha8(lexicographically smallest member name).
- Family cumulative CPU is the sum of `ATTEMPTS.cpu_children_s` over v1 members.

This defeats salami-slicing, and the T1 'cannot' list removes its payoff.

## 5. Roles and independence

1. **Executor** (usually Codex; Claude in its own deliveries).
   - Writes ENDPOINT_LOCK, params.json, admit.py, the learner and the runner.
   - Runs everything through `launch` and runs the gates.
   - Trusted at T1 only.
   - Never writes measurements or verdicts.
2. **Program checker** (`tools/minifly_check`).
   - Written once and corpus-tested.
   - Owns: own-EOS recomputation, truth semantics for addition, strata, determinacy, shortcut ladder, decision rule, G, OLD guard, UDI, OC and claim generation.
   - This removes per-delivery common-mode auditors at the root: no delivery code computes the gated metric or the verdict.
3. **Reviewer** (the other agent family).
   - Required once per T2 delivery.
   - Runs executed checks and the cheapest-shortcut attempt, chooses the canary seed after the lock, attests lock shas, holds the seal nonce for SEALED_CONFIRM, and replays official histories for SEALED_CONFIRM or adoption.
   - Identity is derived from the `Acting-Agent:` commit trailer plus the remote branch namespace containing the commit (`origin/claude/*` vs `origin/codex/*`). Never from git author: Codex commits as 'Pencilbard'.
4. **Owner** (Mr. Zhou). Sole authority for:
   - CONSTRAINTS, threshold floors and tier thresholds;
   - waivers;
   - amendments of primary or guards after outcomes;
   - adoption and pointer authorization;
   - loosening any check or skill;
   - official GO.

   Agents transcribe his words verbatim and he spot-checks them. At each census he traces 3 random CLAIM numbers to raw artifacts.
5. **Held-out author** (the owner, or a fresh session that has not read `tools/minifly_check/*.py`). Writes sealed canary batches from FAILURE_CLASSES definitions and SCHEMAS.md only.

**Single-agent mode.** If the other family is unavailable:
- T2 roster spend may proceed only with a REVIEW_DEBT row, labelled DEV or PILOT.
- SEALED_CONFIRM, findings activation, adoption and pointer updates are blocked until a real cross-family review repays the debt.
- At 3 or more open debts program-wide, no new T2 roster may start.
- A same-family subagent review is debt, not review.

**Stated independence limits.**
- In-repo identity is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof. Codex can write any trailer or branch.
- USER_DECISIONS rows are agent-transcribed.
- The checker is a new program-wide common mode. This is mitigated by:
  - hand-computed clean fixtures;
  - `selftest --mutate`;
  - reviewer trace-a-number checks;
  - the owner spot-check.

   - held-out recall;
   - prune review, using measured gate runtime and catch counts only;
   - KB diagnostics;
   - owner spot-check.
9. Meta-Goodhart rules:
   - never optimize prompts or skills against flag counts;
   - never cite pass counts as progress;
   - a canary fix must not string-match canary literals;
   - the delivering agent's lessons are inputs to independent review.

References:
- CHANGE_CLASSES.md: classification table and direction map.
- HELDOUT_CANARIES.md: batch authoring, sealing, reveal, scoring, burn.

Covers FM-15, 26 and 30, plus parts of 27 and 28.
